analogy.rationale: DNA synthesis inhibitors block S-phase replication, so drugs hitting other nucleotide-synthesis or replication enzymes (polymerase, ribonucleotide reductase, thymidylate synthase, DHFR) should phenocopy the DNA-damage/replication-stress transcriptional program, while the annotated ribosomal-protein targets suggest some off-pathway translation-related signal.
